name: js-ts-accept-js-extensions
body: The JS/TS frontend must include .js, .jsx, .mjs, and .cjs sources alongside .ts/.tsx, using the TypeScript compiler's allowJs (with checkJs/JSDoc where present), jsx, and the compiler's module resolution: CJS require/module.exports, ESM import/export, package.json exports/main, .js↔.ts, and .d.ts. node_modules stays always-skipped. AC: a repo containing only .js/.mjs produces modules, symbols, and edges; a mixed repo resolves a .js import to its .ts definition and vice versa.
